classified.reason: The exact four-worker executor is owned by this whole Test and always shutdownNow then awaitTermination10s asserted in finally. Barrier5s and every Futureget5s are bounded. Explicit bounded termination replaces Java25 ExecutorService.close unbounded wait per BUG2795. Timeout or failed join fails the Test; no backend/process/keyfile is accessed.
classified.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use

classified.reason: This J2EE-container thread restriction does not apply to the standalone JUnit four-worker RFC public-signature verification fixture. It owns its pool, uses barrier5s/Futureget5s and unconditional shutdownNow/await10s asserted. No private key, signing, deployed artifact, app server, Root capability, backend or native FD is involved; immutable public verification outcome and actual worker completion are both required.
classified.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
